findings.label: B7 short landing at paragraph end

findings.label: D9 follows the source order
examples: 1/1 paragraphs follow the source's points in its order (agreement 1.00); fine if each part notices something; check T13 and T09 in the tell ledger
findings.reason: It is Emulate's rewrite of the words it replaces (SOURCE.txt), so it follows their points in order by design; the turns are Emulate's own ("do I need to set as a result", "What’s theirs and what’s mine?").

findings.label: O29 a run of three or more questions (gate step 7: "a few shared AI micro-patterns (question runs, triads, "isn't X, it's Y")"; its prediction review: "questions the text answers itself"): keep the ones a reader would ask
examples: 3 questions: What boundaries do I need to set as a result? What shaped the other person(s) into someone capable of that harm? What’s theirs and what’s mine?
findings.reason: His published forgiveness questions are a run of questions ("What happened?" "What was the impact?" "What boundaries are still needed?" ...); the change rewords two of them in place and merges his "theirs" and "mine" into one.
